name: SRKKAI
recent: SRKK AI 在 2026 年 11 月 13 日公布季度业绩，媒体报导其第三季利润按年增长约 12% 至 15%，并提及公司正转向 AI 平台业务模式以寻求经常性收入。此外，公司于同日公告与关联方的经常性关联交易金额已超过净资产 1% 的门槛。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
公告与关联方进行的经常性关联交易金额超过 2025 年 12 月 31 日经审计合并净资产的 1%。
媒体报导公司正转向 AI 平台业务模式，并计划在三年内从印尼市场取得收入贡献。
risks: 经常性关联交易金额超过净资产 1%，需关注关联交易的持续性与定价公允性。

recent_en: SRKK AI announced its quarterly results on 13 November 2026, with media reporting Q3 profit growth of about 12% to 15% year-on-year and noting the company's pivot towards an AI platform business model to seek recurring revenue. On the same day, it also announced that recurrent related party transactions had exceeded the 1% of net assets threshold.
notable_en: Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Announced that recurrent related party transactions exceeded 1% of the audited consolidated net assets as at 31 December 2025.
Media reported the company's pivot towards an AI platform business model and its plan to secure revenue contribution from Indonesia within three years.
risks_en: Recurrent related party transactions exceeded 1% of net assets; the continuity and pricing fairness of such transactions warrant attention.
